newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi ups Arab Medium, Heavy crude price to Asia.
newsitem.headline: Saudi ups Arab Medium, Heavy crude price to Asia.

text.p: Saudi Arabia said it will raise its July-lifting crude oil price formula to Asian customers by 10 cents a barrel for Arab Medium and by 15 cents for Arab Heavy crude, traders here said on Thursday.
The July term crude price for Arab Light was left unchanged from June at the Oman/Dubai average plus 40 cents, traders said.
Arab Medium was set at the Oman/Dubai average minus 40 cents for July, compared with minus 50 cents in June, traders said.
Arab Heavy was set at the Oman/Dubai average minus $1.20 for July, compared with minus $1.35 in June.
Berri Extra Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus $1.05 in July, down 20 cents from June, traders said.
